parameters.name: ConnectorId
parameters.description: The connector ID. You can call [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~) to query connector IDs.

parameters.name: DevTag
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ConnectorClient device. You can call [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~) to query connector information.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The connection status of the ConnectorClient. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: connected.
- **Disabled**: disconnected.
